from collections import Counter
from functools import reduce
from math import gcd


def _lattice(coords):
    coords = sorted(set(coords))
    if len(coords) < 2:
        return coords
    step = reduce(gcd, (b - a for a, b in zip(coords, coords[1:])))
    return list(range(coords[0], coords[-1] + 1, step))


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    divider = counts.most_common(2)[1][0]
    markers = set(counts) - {background, divider}
    marked_rows = [r for r in range(h) if any(v in markers for v in grid[r])]
    marked_cols = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] in markers for r in range(h))]
    rows, cols = _lattice(marked_rows), _lattice(marked_cols)
    if len(rows) < 2 or len(cols) < 2:
        return grid
    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        outrow = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            a, b = grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]]
            c, d = grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]]
            outrow.append(a if a == b == c == d and a in markers else background)
        out.append(outrow)
    return out
